card.text: Explore Squannit, the companion of Moshup, through its radar-derived shape model.

introduction.text: Squannit is Moshup’s companion, formerly 1999 KW4 Beta. This is the original JPL radar-derived shape model. Radar constrains its broad figure, while visible-light terrain and current rotational phase remain unmapped. The grid marks unmapped terrain. Later mutual-event photometry favors roughly 1.3 times the original radar model’s linear scale. This view retains the original 2006 mesh dimensions. Its orbit is approximate context from a published model extrapolated beyond the 2000–2019 observations.

model.title: Radar shape model
model.summary: JPL radar shape model of 1999 KW 4 Beta, with finite resolution and uneven radar coverage. The original mesh is retained before simplification. Display phase is arbitrary; libration is not reproduced. The grid marks unmapped visible-light terrain. Later mutual-event photometry favors roughly 1.3 times the original radar model’s linear scale. This view retains the original 2006 mesh dimensions.
